manual_discovery_ip_addresses.label: Manual SoundBridge Hosts
manual_discovery_ip_addresses.description: Optional list of SoundBridge devices to connect to when mDNS discovery is unavailable (for example across VLANs). Enter one host per line as host or host:port (default RCP port is 5555).

manifest.description: Stream music to Roku and Pinnacle SoundBridge network music players over the RCP protocol.
